geometry.locator: NuMI Facility TDR (FERMILAB-DESIGN-1998-01) Appendix A, beam sheet 'Site coordinates for beamline: horn2.ces' (DUSAF x, y in ft; station along the beam in ft)
geometry.note: Three independent tests of the conversion: A0 maps back to its own published coordinate; the bearing from this point to the published MINOS far-detector coordinate (47.820267 N, 92.241412 W) is 336.169 deg against 336.177 deg for the sheet's own beam axis; the 8 GeV line start in the MI TDR converts to within 1 m of the Booster ring radius.

method: Published coordinates converted to WGS 84. The NuMI TDR beam sheet lists the target (type TAR-2, location HALTA, station 1146.09958 ft) at DUSAF x = 100327.838 ft, y = 97780.188 ft. Conversion of DUSAF to WGS 84: DUSAF x, y (ft) are the FSCS coordinates of Beams-doc-1148 (origin A0 = 41°50′14.312704″ N, 88°15′41.143123″ W, false x = y = 100000 ft, +y axis at geodetic azimuth 38°16′48.01429″, scale 1.000029251 at A0), applied as a rotated tangent plane on the GRS80 ellipsoid (difference to the double stereographic projection below 0.2 m within 1.5 km of A0). NAD83 and WGS 84 are taken as equal. Replaces the earlier derived point (41.8310919, -88.2651363), which placed the target 1040 m upstream of the OSM MINOS surface building and was 103 m from this position because the MINOS shaft building stands 79 m south-east of the hall (MINOS NIM paper: the cart is pulled about 80 m from the shaft base into the hall).
